train_holdout_split.selection_rule: For each of the 10 categories that have exactly 3 numbered prompts, the highest-numbered prompt (suffix _3) is assigned to holdout; the other two (_1, _2) go to train. code_reasoning has only one prompt (code_reasoning_1, no _3 sibling) and is assigned to train. This rule was fixed and written to disk BEFORE any Phase 11C ablation, ranking, or quality result was computed or observed -- it depends only on prompt LABELS (fixed since Phase 10C), never on any Phase 11C measurement.
train_holdout_split.note: code_reasoning (1 prompt total) has no holdout representative -- disclosed limitation, not hidden.
